title: Missing from the Google 3-pack for core '<city> rehab' searches; GBP rating trails every competitor in the pack
evidence: 'alcohol rehab Nashville TN': 3-pack = recoveryunplugged.com, southeastaddictiontn.com, nashvilleaddictionrecovery.com -> NOT in pack; organic position 6
'drug rehab Nashville': 3-pack = southeastaddictiontn.com, nashvilleaddictionrecovery.com, recoveryunplugged.com -> NOT in pack; organic position 5
'detox Nashville TN': 3-pack = brentwoodspringsdetox.com, liveagaindetox.com, detox-nashville.com -> NOT in pack; organic position 8
'inpatient rehab Nashville TN': 3-pack = recoveryunplugged.com, southeastaddictiontn.com, epiphanywellnesscenters.org -> NOT in pack; organic position 8
'rehab centers Nashville': 3-pack = southeastaddictiontn.com, cumberlandheights.org, treehouserecoverytn.com -> IN pack; organic position 6
Google Maps 'alcohol rehab' from city centre: Cumberland Heights Outpatient Addiction Treatment (Nashville | Music Row) at #7, rating 4.6 (9 reviews)

top 3 there: Southeast Addiction Center - Nashville Drug & Alcohol Rehab Center 4.9★ (104); Live Again Detox - Alcohol & Drug Detox Center in Nashville 4.9★ (148); Nashville Treatment Solutions 4.7★ (104)
Google Maps 'drug rehab' from city centre: Cumberland Heights Outpatient Addiction Treatment (Nashville | Music Row) at #7, rating 4.6 (9 reviews)

top 3 there: Nashville Treatment Solutions 4.7★ (104); Live Again Detox - Alcohol & Drug Detox Center in Nashville 4.9★ (148); Southeast Addiction Center - Nashville Drug & Alcohol Rehab Center 4.9★ (104)

Own GBP listings seen in local packs: Cumberland Heights Treatment Center 4★ (239); Cumberland Heights Treatment Center 4★ (234); Cumberland Heights Treatment Center 4★ (230); Cumberland Heights Treatment Center 4★ (229)
Rating gap: main listing 4★ vs 4.8★ average for the top-3 Maps results
why_it_matters: The 3-pack sits above the #1 organic result on mobile and has a tap-to-call button, so it takes the largest share of calls for '<city> rehab' queries. Rating and review count are the two visible ranking and conversion levers; a 4.0 next to three 4.9s loses the tap even when it appears.
fix: A review program (ask at discharge and from alumni, respond to every review, address the 1-star themes); align GBP name, categories, services, hours, photos and phone with the site; link each GBP to its own location page with UTM tags; add Joint Commission and insurance in the GBP description.
check_first: GBP Insights per listing: calls, direction requests and website clicks by query; call tracking on the GBP number vs the site number; GSC brand-query trend after review push.

title: Every commercial '<city> rehab' keyword ranks through the homepage; no program or location page ranks for them
evidence: 13 of 13 non-brand local treatment keywords in the top-ranking set are ranked by the homepage, not a program or location page
Homepage title: 'Home - Cumberland Heights' · H1: ['Tennessee’s Most Trusted Addiction Treatment Center Since 1966']
'drug treatment nashville tn' vol 2400/mo, CPC $91, position 1 -> www.cumberlandheights.org/
'rehabs nashville tn' vol 2400/mo, CPC $91, position 1 -> www.cumberlandheights.org/
'addiction rehab nashville' vol 2400/mo, CPC $91, position 2 -> www.cumberlandheights.org/
why_it_matters: These are the highest-value queries in the market (CPCs near $90 say what a click is worth). A generic homepage caps click-through and sends every intent to one page; competitors rank city + program landing pages with the phone number and program in the title.
fix: Rewrite the homepage title/H1 to say what and where ('<Brand> | Alcohol & Drug Rehab in <City>, <ST>'). Build or upgrade one page per city + level of care (detox, residential, IOP) and per location, each with NAP, schema, insurance and FAQ, then internally link them from the homepage hero.
check_first: GSC Performance, homepage, queries containing the city: impressions, CTR and position. Compare CTR to the 5-8% typical at position 1-3; the gap is the title problem. Then check which program URLs get impressions for '<city> detox' etc.

why_it_matters: A growing share of 'best rehab near me' research starts in ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews. The sources those answers cite (directories, competitors) get the call.

title: Program and blog pages lack medical reviewer / author bylines
evidence: 2 of 32 program/content pages show 'medically reviewed' or a credentialed byline
why_it_matters: Health content without visible expertise ranks worse after Google's helpful-content/E-E-A-T updates and is less likely to be cited by AI engines.
fix: Add 'Medically reviewed by <Name, credentials>' with a linked bio to every program and blog page.
check_first: GSC: did blog/program clicks drop around core updates? Which pages lost positions 1-5?

title: Program pages have no FAQ / direct-answer sections
evidence: 1 of 30 program pages have 3+ question headings or FAQPage schema
why_it_matters: AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity lift 40-80 word passages that answer a question directly (cost, length of stay, insurance, detox). Without them the site is paraphrased from directories instead of cited.
fix: Add a 4-6 question FAQ to every program/location page (what it costs, insurance, how long, what to bring, visiting, detox) with FAQPage JSON-LD.
check_first: GSC: question-style queries ('how long', 'does', 'what is') where the site ranks 5-15.

title: Organic traffic is mostly informational blog visits, not local treatment seekers
evidence: Top 100 ranking keywords by estimated traffic (DataForSEO): 77% of estimated visits land on blog/archive pages, 23% on home/program/location/admissions pages
www.cumberlandheights.org/resources/blog/what-are-the-rules-of-the-12-step-program/: ~22639 visits/mo from e.g. '12 step program aa'
www.cumberlandheights.org/resources/blog/non-stimulant-adhd-medication/: ~822 visits/mo from e.g. 'non stimulant adhd drugs'
why_it_matters: Traffic reports look healthy while the pages that produce calls get a sliver. Informational queries are also the ones AI Overviews now answer in-SERP, so this traffic is the most exposed to decline.
fix: Judge SEO on calls from program/location/admissions pages, not sessions. Keep the blog for E-E-A-T and AI citations, but route it: every post gets a program CTA block, and internal links from top posts to the matching program page.
check_first: GSC: clicks by page grouped into blog vs program URLs; GA4/call tracking: calls per landing page group. If blog pages produce under 5% of calls, reallocate content budget to city + program pages.

title: Thin program/location/admissions pages (under 300 words)
why_it_matters: Pages that cannot answer 'what happens, who is it for, what does it cost, is it covered' rarely rank for city + program queries and are rarely quoted by AI engines.
fix: Expand each to cover program description, levels of care, insurance, admission steps, staff, FAQ.
check_first: GSC: impressions vs clicks per page; which program queries do these pages appear for at position 8-20?

title: Missing or duplicate title tags
evidence: 'On the Wagon: Sober Open Mic Night - Cumberland Heights' used on 4 pages
why_it_matters: The title is the ad headline in search; duplicates make program pages compete with each other.
fix: Unique titles: '<Program> in <City>, <ST> | <Brand>'.
check_first: GSC Performance: pages with high impressions and CTR under 2%.

title: Google AI Overviews cite the site only for blog posts, never for a program, location or admissions page
evidence: Google AI Overviews cite the domain for 417 keywords; of the top 100 by volume, 99 are blog posts and 1 are program/location/admissions pages

Examples: '12 step' (22200/mo) -> /resources/blog/what-are-the-rules-of-the-12-step-program/; '12 steps' (22200/mo) -> /resources/blog/what-are-the-rules-of-the-12-step-program/; 'is ganja addictive' (9900/mo) -> /resources/blog/debunking-myths-understanding-the-reality-of-marijuana-addiction/; 'what are the 12 steps' (8100/mo) -> /resources/blog/what-are-the-rules-of-the-12-step-program/
AI Overview shown on commercial queries: Cumberland Heights (check by hand whether the site is cited there)
why_it_matters: AI Overviews and AI Mode are replacing the top organic slot for question-style queries. Being cited for 'what are the 12 steps' earns nothing; being cited for 'how much does rehab cost in <city>' or 'does <brand> take <insurer>' earns calls.
fix: Turn program and admissions pages into citable answers: a direct 40-80 word answer under each H2, FAQPage schema, cost/insurance/length-of-stay facts stated plainly, named clinicians, and a comparison page for '<city> rehab options'.
check_first: GSC: filter queries starting with 'how', 'does', 'what', 'cost' where the site ranks 4-15; those are the AI Overview candidates. Track brand searches as the AI exposure proxy.

title: Missing or multiple H1 headings
evidence: 7 pages with no H1, 0 with more than one
why_it_matters: Weak topical signal for program/location pages.
fix: One H1 per page naming the service and place.
check_first: None needed; template fix.

title: Same address written in different ways across the site
evidence: '8283 River Rd Pike Nashville, TN 37209' (51 pages) | '8283 River Road Pike Nashville, TN 37209' (1 pages)
'6650 East Brainerd Rd Suite 102 Chattanooga, TN 37421' (1 pages) | '6650 East Brainerd Road, Suite 102 Chattanooga, TN 37421' (1 pages)
'219 B Dunbar Cave Rd Clarksville, TN 37043' (1 pages) | '219 B Dunbar Cave Road Clarksville, TN 37043' (1 pages)
why_it_matters: NAP inconsistency between site, GBP and citations erodes local pack trust.
fix: Pick one canonical format per facility (match GBP exactly) and use it in footer, location pages and schema.
check_first: Compare against GBP listing and top citations (Psychology Today, SAMHSA locator).

title: 6 different phone numbers in tel: links
why_it_matters: Multiple numbers can be legitimate call-tracking swaps, but if they are hard-coded they fragment NAP consistency and Google Business Profile matching.
fix: One primary admissions number in schema and footer; use dynamic number insertion (CallRail/CTM) for tracking rather than hard-coded variants.
check_first: Call tracking: are these pool numbers? If any number is not in the tracking tool, find who owns it.

title: Link profile is shrinking and leans on low-quality rehab directories
evidence: Referring domains 944, backlinks 4810, domain rank 44, spam score 41
why_it_matters: Authority decides who wins the organic #1 for '<city> rehab' once titles and pages are fixed; a decaying profile with directory-heavy links is a slow leak, not an emergency.
fix: Earn links where families and referrers already are: local news, hospital systems, university partnerships, state/county resources, alumni stories; disavow nothing yet, audit the 'rehab*.us' style directories.
check_first: GSC Links report: top linking sites and the pages they link to; watch whether referring domains keep dropping month over month.

title: Homepage lacks a complete Organization/MedicalOrganization schema
evidence: telephone: no, address: no, sameAs: no
why_it_matters: Entity data (name, phone, address, sameAs to GBP/Wikipedia/socials) is how Google and AI engines confirm who you are. It feeds the knowledge panel and AI answer citations.
fix: Add MedicalOrganization JSON-LD with name, url, logo, telephone, address, areaServed, medicalSpecialty, sameAs[].
check_first: GSC: Enhancements/Rich results reports; search the brand name and see whether a knowledge panel appears.

title: Accreditation mentioned on the site but not on the homepage
why_it_matters: Most first visits land on the homepage; the seal belongs there and in the footer.
fix: Add the seal and a one-line statement to the footer template.
check_first: None.

title: Internal links to broken (4xx/5xx) pages
why_it_matters: A prospect clicking a dead 'Admissions' or program link leaves; link equity is lost.
fix: Redirect or fix the targets, then update the source links.
check_first: GSC > Pages > Not found (404): which have impressions? Call tracking: calls from these landing URLs before they broke.

title: No LegitScript certification mentioned
why_it_matters: LegitScript certification is required to run Google/Meta ads for addiction treatment and is a visible trust badge; its absence may also mean paid search is unavailable.
fix: Get certified (if not) and show the badge in the footer.
check_first: Check legitscript.com certified list for the facility.

title: Sitemap lists URLs that do not return 200
why_it_matters: Google trusts the sitemap less and wastes crawl budget on dead URLs.
fix: Regenerate the sitemap from live, indexable URLs only.
check_first: GSC > Pages > 'Not found (404)' and 'Redirect error' filtered to sitemap URLs.

title: No staff page with clinical credentials found
evidence: 0 staff/team pages crawled; none list MD/LCSW/LADAC-style credentials in text
why_it_matters: Named clinicians with credentials are what families, Google raters and AI engines use to judge legitimacy.
fix: Clinical team page with photo, name, credentials, role; Person schema.
